Subject: Post-call recap + implementation roadmap for Andromeda Health — next steps & signoff

Hi Jenna,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — really useful to walk through your ingestion & privacy constraints and align on success criteria. Per our discussion, I captured an initial implementation roadmap below and attached a draft we can iterate on.

High-level objectives (what success looks like)
- Production inference for triage summarization across 3 clinical teams (avg latency <= 350ms per request with 95th pctn)
- Monthly token cost target: <= $0.0025/token on average after batching and caching
- End-to-end HIPAA controls in place (VPC + KMS + audit logging)

Proposed milestones & owners (draft)
1) Pilot setup (env & model selection) — target complete: 2027-01-28 — Owner: Aditya Rao (redwood) + Ethan Park (Andromeda)
2) Integration & data pipeline validation — target: 2027-02-04 — Owner: Monica Patel (redwood) + Andromeda engineering
3) Security review & legal checklist complete — target: 2027-02-08 — Owner: Marissa Cole (redwood legal) + Andromeda procurement
4) Canary launch (limited traffic) — target: 2027-02-14 (Valentine's day go-live?) — Owner: Rishi Malhotra (redwood infra)
5) Full rollout & QPS bump — target: 2027-02-21 — Owner: Andromeda engineering / Redwood ops

Dependencies we noted
- KMS integration for key rotation (Andromeda IT)
- SOC2 attestation on retention settings (Redwood to provide evidence)
- Procurement terms & PO (Andromeda procurement)

Next steps I propose
- Aditya to share exact pilot instance sizing and cost estimate by 2027-01-12 (attached: Andromeda_Roadmap_v1.xlsx)
- Jenna / procurement to confirm PO timeline and any legal questions by 2027-01-14
- Marissa (legal) to review the MAP draft and flag any items by 2027-01-15

If those dates work for you, I will circulate an updated MAP and a DocuSign link once we incorporate legal notes.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Hi Jenna and team —

Attached is an updated MAP (Andromeda_Roadmap_v2.xlsx) with refined pilot instance sizes, cost breakdown (pilot vs. steady state), and a short Appendix on KMS behavior. Highlights:
- Pilot sizing: 2x g5.48 (auto-burst to 4x for 48 hours) to hit the 95th pctn latency with parallelism; pilot est. monthly cost ~ $6,200 (pro-rated for pilot window)
- Batching & cache recommendations to hit target token cost: sample config included
- KMS notes: Redwood does not store plaintext customer data outside of encrypted storage; key material is customer-managed by default for Private deployments; hosted API uses tenant-isolated encryption with customer KMS options. See Appendix B in the attached.

Action items I took from the call:
- Lauren: send DocuSign link once legal notes are in
- Marissa: review section 3 (data handling) and confirm we can provide the SOC2 artifacts they requested
- Jenna / Procurement: confirm PO lead time and any restrictive clauses by 2027-01-14

I can hop on a short call if you want to walk the Appendix — happy to make it concrete.

—Aditya
